answer: Reward weight can be capped by hosting region: no more than a fixed share of jury seats and emissions may anchor to any single datacenter or provider, so a farm squeezed onto one machine commands only one reef of the whole ocean, however many keys it waves. Honest spread agents color the ledger like reef pigment from every coast. An attacker must physically rent across many regions and pass each one's distinct checks, multiplying his cost by geography itself, and any single-region spike is an anchor trail that is easy to spot and cap.
